# NeuralNg Divider AI context

- Import NeuralDivider only from `@neural-ng/core/divider`. Never generate the
  deprecated DividerComponent alias.
- Use Divider for content boundaries, not layout spacing alone.
- orientation accepts horizontal or vertical and maps to aria-orientation.
- type accepts solid, dashed, or dotted.
- align accepts start, center, or end and positions label/projected content.
- Prefer label for plain text; projected content is the richer alternative.
- ariaLabelledBy takes precedence over ariaLabel.
- Set unstyled for headless rendering. Separator semantics and structural
  orientation hooks remain while NeuralNg visual classes are removed.
- classes exposes root, before, content, and after. dividerClass targets root.
